description: Build high-fidelity custom charts inside Databricks AI/BI (Lakeview) dashboards using Vega-Lite custom visualizations (Public Preview). Covers the documented contract — the `databricks_query` data source, Fields-section Name references, theme-aware signals (`colors`, `mode`, `dashboardTheme`), and cross-filtering via the reserved `databricks_mark_selection` parameter. Use when the built-in widget types in 02-databricks-aibi-dashboards cannot express the chart you need, but you still want a documented, per-widget, cross-filter-capable visualization. For full-page bespoke React layouts (composite cards, KPI tiles, in-cell sparklines), see 06-databricks-aibi-custom-pages-react.
